rateLimits.note: TheFork Partners API Terms of Use 5.3: 200 API calls a minute, the default, negotiable; each route may get its own limit.
TheFork Partners API Terms of Use 5.3: 10,000 API calls a day, the default, negotiable with the partner's booking volumes.

provenance.notes: Contract-only: credentials from TheFork; "Rate limiting is currently enforced at the default level as outlined in your contract" (B2B API introduction), the terms' default declared. Caching of TheFork's data needs its prior approval (5.4, hence contract); forwarding any data is strictly prohibited (5.2, redistribution forbidden); an error rate above 10% of bookings may cost the access. A 429 comes from the API gateway before the request reaches the endpoint (openapi.json): the reservation was not made. No idempotency key on reservation creation: Omnifood sends it once, never retried.
